leadText:
By Your Side (Korean: 너와 함께라면 Neowa Hamkkeramyeon, transl. "If I Were With You") is the ending theme for the Korean dub of the Liko and Roy's Departure and The Sparkling of Terapagos arcs and the first of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ001, replacing We Are All Friends. The ending animation is composed of various episode clips from Pokémon Horizons: The Series, and does not contain any footage from its corresponding Japanese ending theme, RVR ~Rising Volt Tacklers Rap~.

The full version of the song was released as a digital single on August 23, 2023. The song was uploaded to the official Korean Pokémon YouTube channel on August 27, 2023.
